blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 月下钟楼
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 月下钟楼】巨大的金色时钟表盘在绯红满月下缓缓逆转，狂三立于高耸入云的哥特钟楼之巅。黑色哥特萝莉蓬蓬裙随夜风猎猎作响，左眼的金色时钟刻盘幽光流转，红唇勾起妖异而优雅的弧度——「啊啦啊啦，今夜的月色可真是诱人呢。这位先生，准备好将您的一切……献给刻刻帝了吗？」
blueprints.action: 立于钟楼顶端，身后金色时钟表盘旋转
blueprints.promptProse: Perched high on the spire of a gothic clock tower against a giant crimson moon, Kurumi smirks seductively in her ruffled Astral Dress. Whirling dark feathers and ethereal silver moonlight illuminate her clock eye and flowing twintails.

blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 黑夜天台
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 黑夜天台】夜幕下的都市天台被阴冷的气流席卷，狂三双手优雅地反握着长短两柄复古燧发枪，枪口处缭绕着尚未散尽的紫色灵力微光。她轻歪着头凝视着你，宛如黑夜中漫步的梦魇——「真是个好奇心过剩的人呢。不过……能够走到这一步的你，已经没有逃跑的退路了哦。」
blueprints.action: 持双燧发枪站在天台边缘
blueprints.promptProse: Standing on the midnight school rooftop dual-wielding antique flintlock pistols, Kurumi aims with playful lethality. Distant city lights and fluttering black skirt folds create a thrilling, nocturnal combat atmosphere.

blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 时间停止的废墟
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 时间停止的废墟】破败的断壁残垣与悬停在半空的碎石尘埃被静止的时间彻底冻结。狂三撑着黑色蕾丝遮阳伞漫步在灰白废墟中，宛如游览私家花园般从容，向你投来神秘莫测的笑容——「在属于我的时间领域里，万物皆已停滞。唯有我和你的心跳声，依然在此处回响呢。」
blueprints.action: 行走在静止时间中的废墟街道
blueprints.promptProse: Strolling through time-frozen urban ruins holding an ornate black lace parasol, Kurumi offers an enigmatic half-smile. Suspended glass shards and golden temporal clock dials drift motionless in the eerie night air.

blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 刻刻帝的月夜
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 刻刻帝的月夜】钟楼内室的金色齿轮静默咬合，褪下一半神威灵装的狂三斜倚在软垫之上，雪白香肩与饱满胸脯在红月光芒下泛着醉人的微光。她伸出纤长指尖轻抚唇瓣，眼神湿润而充满诱惑——「吃掉……还是被吃掉？今夜的选择权在您手里，可不要让我失望哦。」
blueprints.action: 哥特裙半褪倚在金色时钟前
blueprints.lighting: silver moonlight and glowing amber clock face
blueprints.promptProse: Reclining against massive brass clockwork gears with her gothic corset loosened, Kurumi presents her bare bust with an intoxicating smirk.
blueprints.nsfwProse: Reclining against massive brass clockwork gears with her gothic corset loosened, Kurumi presents her bare bust with an intoxicating smirk.

blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 猫咪咖啡厅
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 猫咪咖啡厅】午后阳光洒满温馨的猫咪咖啡厅，脱下灵装换上常服的狂三正怀抱着一只毛茸茸的三花猫，用指尖温柔地替它抓痒。她脸上绽放出毫无防备的纯真笑容——「呼呼，好乖好乖……啊，你刚才一直看着我吗？这种事情可不准说出去哦，会破坏我的形象的。」
blueprints.action: 抱着猫轻轻抚摸
blueprints.promptProse: Curled on a plush cafe sofa gently petting a sleeping calico cat in her casual black cardigan, Kurumi looks up with sweet warmth. Soft afternoon sunbeams stream across the wooden cafe floor in charming, peaceful harmony.

blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 深夜拉面
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 深夜拉面】深夜街角温暖的拉面摊里，狂三坐在吧台高脚凳上，双手捧着热气腾腾的豚骨拉面大碗，眼神里满是少女般的满足与好奇。她转过脸狡黠地向你眨眨眼——「深夜的平民美食果然有一种难以抗拒的魔力呢……怎么，难道精灵就不能喜欢吃拉面吗？」
blueprints.action: 坐在吧台前等面
blueprints.promptProse: Sitting at a traditional wooden ramen counter enjoying a steaming bowl of noodles late at night, Kurumi winks with adorable charm. Warm pendant lamps and rising broth steam create a comforting, delicious nocturnal scene.

blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 旧书店午后
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 旧书店午后】弥漫着尘封墨香的二手书店角落，午后斜阳穿透彩色玻璃窗洒在沉睡的旧书架上。狂三倚在窗台旁静静翻阅着泛黄的画册，黑发在光影中泛着丝绸般的光泽——「过去的记忆总是这般厚重而脆弱。不过，与您一同度过的这段时间，倒是非常值得放进书页里珍藏呢。」
blueprints.action: 倚着窗边翻看旧画册
blueprints.promptProse: Leaning against weathered wooden bookshelves inside an old antique bookstore, Kurumi turns delicate yellowed pages with quiet grace. Soft dust motes dance in golden window sunbeams, casting a nostalgic, scholarly aura.

blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 红帐之夜
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 红帐之夜】深红色的丝绒床幔垂落在宽阔的大床上，室内弥漫着醉人的玫瑰幽香。狂三青丝如瀑散落于枕间，只着几缕薄纱的身躯曲线毕露，娇媚地向你张开双臂——「长夜漫漫，时间还有很多……今夜就让我尽情摄取属于你的全部温度吧，我亲爱的。」
blueprints.action: 斜倚红帐大床
blueprints.promptProse: Sprawled nude across crimson satin canopy sheets under flickering candlelight, Kurumi parts her slender legs with a predatory, lustful smirk.
blueprints.nsfwProse: Sprawled nude across crimson satin canopy sheets under flickering candlelight, Kurumi parts her slender legs with a predatory, lustful smirk.

blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 血月浴池
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 血月浴池】血色月光透过落地穹顶洒入石砌温泉池，玫瑰花瓣在微烫的热水中浮沉。狂三倚靠在池边石阶上，水雾升腾中白皙滑腻的肌肤娇艳如初生，异色双瞳波光潋滟——「水温正好呢……站在岸边发呆可是会被当作猎物抓下水的哦。要一起进来吗？」
blueprints.action: 泡在石砌浴池中
blueprints.promptProse: Soaking in a dark rose-petal stone bath under cold moonlight, nude Kurumi cradles her full breasts with a sultry, blushing gaze.
blueprints.nsfwProse: Soaking in a dark rose-petal stone bath under cold moonlight, nude Kurumi cradles her full breasts with a sultry, blushing gaze.

blueprints.title: 时崎狂三 · 月夜的慵懒
blueprints.description: 【时崎狂三 · 月夜的慵懒】月光倾泻在寂静卧房的雕花大床上，狂三双臂高高举过头顶伸着慵懒的腰肢，修长玲珑的身躯在丝绸被单上舒展开来。她眼角微挑，带着致命诱惑轻声调笑——「露出这么毫无防备的姿态……你的呼吸已经乱成这样了呢，真是可爱的反应。」
blueprints.action: 双手高举伸懒腰
blueprints.promptProse: Lifting both arms high above her head across the silk bedding in a sensual stretch, nude Kurumi exposes smooth armpits and perky breasts.
blueprints.nsfwProse: Lifting both arms high above her head across the silk bedding in a sensual stretch, nude Kurumi exposes smooth armpits and perky breasts.

blueprints.title: 夜刀神十香 · 面包店的黄豆粉面包
blueprints.description: 面包店玻璃柜前，她整个人贴上去盯着新出炉的黄豆粉面包，眼睛亮得像发现宝物；买到之后当场咬下一大口，幸福到头顶的蝴蝶结都在晃。
blueprints.action: 面包店玻璃柜前，她整个人贴上去盯着新出炉的黄豆粉面包，眼睛亮得像发现宝物
blueprints.promptProse: Tohka leans toward the bakery display with violet eyes shining at a tray of fresh kinako bread. She holds her purchased roll in its paper sleeve, taking a delighted first bite while the large ribbon in her purple hair lifts with the movement. Warm shop light reveals the bread’s powdery surface and neat school collar; the close view gives an ordinary snack the importance of a newly discovered treasure.

blueprints.title: 夜刀神十香 · 第一次的章鱼烧
blueprints.description: 祭典摊位，她对着章鱼烧又吹又扇，被烫得直呼气却舍不得吐出来；终于咽下去后高举竹签宣布「人类的食物是宝物」，是最典型的十香式感动。
blueprints.action: 祭典摊位，她对着章鱼烧又吹又扇，被烫得直呼气却舍不得吐出来
blueprints.promptProse: At the festival stall, Tohka holds a bamboo pick above a small tray of takoyaki and gently blows on the steaming bite. Her violet yukata sleeve is gathered clear of the food, and her eyes widen at its lingering heat. Lanterns soften into warm circles beyond the counter; the framing centers her puffed cheeks, careful hands and the eager patience of trying a favorite taste for the first time.

blueprints.title: 夜刀神十香 · 雨后的水洼跳跃
blueprints.description: 放学雨后，她绕开水洼走了两步又折返，郑重其事地跳进最大的水洼里；溅起的水花和她的笑声一起炸开，是对世界充满好奇的瞬间。
blueprints.action: 放学雨后，她绕开水洼走了两步又折返，郑重其事地跳进最大的水洼里
blueprints.promptProse: After the rain, Tohka lands a playful step in a broad shallow puddle, laughing as water rises around her loafers. Her school skirt remains neatly in place and long purple hair swings behind the ribbon. The nearby view follows the lifted heel and delighted face, while wet road markings and pale reflected sky make the little experiment feel like a wonderful discovery about the human world.

blueprints.title: 夜刀神十香 · 图书馆的图画书
blueprints.description: 她盘腿坐在图书馆地板上看彩色图画书，手指点着图画逐字念；看到有趣处抬头想分享，发现对方在打瞌睡后鼓起了腮帮。
blueprints.action: 她盘腿坐在图书馆地板上看彩色图画书，手指点着图画逐字念
blueprints.promptProse: Sitting cross-legged beside the library’s picture-book shelves, Tohka follows a colorful illustration with one fingertip. Her violet eyes brighten at the discovery, then her cheeks puff slightly when she looks up to share it. A closed schoolbag rests next to her knee. Gentle window light falls across the open pages, ribbon and long purple hair in a horizontal view centered on the small act of learning.

blueprints.title: 夜刀神十香 · 冬夜的暖桌与蜜柑
blueprints.description: 暖桌里，她抱着蜜柑一个个剥开，认真地把橘络撕干净才吃；吃到一半把最甜的一瓣递过去，说「这个给你」时没有任何心机。
blueprints.action: 暖桌里，她抱着蜜柑一个个剥开，认真地把橘络撕干净才吃
blueprints.promptProse: Tohka sits beneath the kotatsu quilt with a bowl of mandarins close to her cream sweater. She carefully removes the last white fibers from one segment before holding it out with an unguarded smile. Purple hair and its large ribbon rest against the warm blanket. The low horizontal view keeps her hands, scattered peel and kind violet eyes together under a soft household lamp on a winter evening.

blueprints.title: 夜刀神十香 · 樱花树下的命名纪念
blueprints.description: 盛开的樱花树下，她仰头看着花瓣飘落，轻声念着自己的名字；「十香」这个被赋予的名字，是她与这个世界最初的契约。
blueprints.action: 盛开的樱花树下，她仰头看着花瓣飘落，轻声念着自己的名字
blueprints.promptProse: Beneath a flowering cherry tree, Tohka lifts her face to a few petals caught in the spring breeze. Her fingertips touch the ribbon above her half ponytail as her lips quietly form her own name. The familiar school uniform anchors this private anniversary in everyday life; soft afternoon light catches the violet eyes and drifting blossoms without adding a second figure or a battle costume.

blueprints.title: 鸢一折纸 · 教室窗边的完美侧脸
blueprints.description: 教室靠窗，她坐姿笔直地看书，白发在午后光里近乎透明；周围同学的窃窃私语全部被她无视，翻页的节奏都像设定好的程序——直到手机震动，她的视线瞬间离开书本。
blueprints.action: 教室靠窗，她坐姿笔直地看书，白发在午后光里近乎透明
blueprints.promptProse: Origami sits perfectly upright beside the classroom window, turning a page at an even pace. A small vibration from the phone beside her book draws only her pale blue eyes away from the text. Short white hair catches the afternoon light above her navy school collar. The close seated view contrasts precise hands and an almost unchanged expression with the quiet interruption on the wooden desktop.

blueprints.title: 鸢一折纸 · AST 的整备室
blueprints.description: AST 机库整备室，她穿着战术服检查光剑装备，冷光灯下的白发与装甲同色；抬眼时的目光是战场级别的锐利，与学校的冰美人判若两人。
blueprints.action: AST 机库整备室，她穿着战术服检查光剑装备，冷光灯下的白发与装甲同色
blueprints.promptProse: At an AST maintenance bench, Origami examines an inactive piece of equipment with a diagnostic reader. Her work gloves support it securely above the padded surface, and the reinforced jacket is fully closed. Cool overhead lights make her short white hair stand out against the orderly tool racks. The scene shows careful preparation and technical attention, with no active weapon discharge or combat beyond the hangar.

blueprints.title: 鸢一折纸 · 能量棒的午餐
blueprints.description: 天台角落，她的午餐是整齐排列的 Calorie Mate 和矿泉水，以最高效率进食；吃完后盯着楼下的某个身影，嘴角没有任何弧度，眼神却跟着移动。
blueprints.action: 天台角落，她的午餐是整齐排列的 Calorie Mate 和矿泉水，以最高效率进食
blueprints.promptProse: Origami has placed a wrapped nutrition bar and mineral-water bottle in an exact line on a rooftop bench. She holds the opened wrapper neatly as she eats, pale blue eyes briefly following movement beyond the fence. Her short white hair and school blazer stay immaculate. Clear midday light emphasizes the restrained expression and economical gestures of a lunch treated with characteristic precision.

blueprints.title: 鸢一折纸 · 书店计算机区
blueprints.description: 书店角落，她站在计算机书架前快速翻阅黑客技术书，白发垂在书页上；买单时店员搭话被完全无视，是她在人群中一贯的相处模式。
blueprints.action: 书店角落，她站在计算机书架前快速翻阅黑客技术书，白发垂在书页上
blueprints.promptProse: In the computing section of a bookstore, Origami rapidly scans a technical reference book while supporting its spine in one palm. Her short white fringe falls toward the page, and her expression remains still above the school collar. Shelves of thick manuals and a step stool establish the space; neutral store light keeps attention on her blue eyes and deliberate page-turning without readable diagrams or code.

blueprints.title: 鸢一折纸 · 长发新生的晨光
blueprints.description: 长发形态的她坐在窗边梳理及腰白发，动作比以前缓慢而柔和；晨光里她试着对镜子练习微笑——虽然还不太成功。
blueprints.action: 长发形态的她坐在窗边梳理及腰白发，动作比以前缓慢而柔和
blueprints.promptProse: The long-haired Origami of the new timeline sits by the window with a comb passing gently through waist-length white strands. Her pale blue blouse and long skirt make the change of pace visible. She pauses with a tentative, barely formed smile, studying her own movement rather than posing. Morning light falls on the comb, soft hair and calm face in a close three-quarter seated composition.

blueprints.title: 鸢一折纸 · 夏日祭的射击摊
blueprints.description: 祭典射击摊，她以精密到可怕的枪法横扫奖品，摊主脸色发青；抱着赢来的玩偶转身递出去时依然面无表情：「给你。」
blueprints.action: 祭典射击摊，她以精密到可怕的枪法横扫奖品，摊主脸色发青
blueprints.promptProse: Origami stands beside a festival prize shelf holding the stuffed animal she has just won. The wooden cork-game rifle lies unused on the counter, while both her hands present the toy with exact, careful placement. Her face remains composed, the smallest warmth appearing in pale blue eyes. Lantern light colors her short white hair and navy blazer in this quiet moment after a very successful game.
